# Counterparty (`counterparty` v1)

A legal entity the bank trades with: identifiers, rating, sector, country and parent group.

**Group:** Counterparty and legal · **Mnemonic:** `CPTY` · **Identifiers:** `CP-…` in `counterpartyId`

Open one with `CPTY <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: counterparty
version: 1
description: "A legal entity the bank trades with: identifiers, rating, sector, country and parent group."
match: { kind: counterparty, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Counterparty and legal · Counterparty, id: $.counterpartyId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: LEI, bind: $.lei }
  - { label: Rating, bind: $.rating, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Sector, bind: $.sector }
  - { label: Country, bind: $.country }
  - { label: Type, bind: $.type }
  - { label: Net MTM, bind: $.netMtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: PFE peak, bind: $.pfePeak, fmt: compact }
panels:
  - id: nettingSets
    kind: table
    title: Netting sets
    key: F2
    rows: $.nettingSets
    columns:
      - { label: Netting set, bind: "@.id" }
      - { label: Agreement, bind: "@.agreement" }
      - { label: Trades, bind: "@.trades", fmt: amount0, total: true }
      - { label: Net MTM, bind: "@.netMtm", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
  - id: kyc
    kind: kv
    title: KYC and classification
    area: right
    rows: $.kyc
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.group, 'counterparty-group')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
